artworks.title: A Thousand Ways of Seeing · Dawn
artworks.description: Many small windows turn toward the world, gathering a thousand glimmers into one gaze. The first glimmers gather at the edge of a new beginning.
artworks.desc: Many small windows turn toward the world, gathering a thousand glimmers into one gaze. The first glimmers gather at the edge of a new beginning.
artworks.scientificDescription: 複眼由數百個六角形小眼並排在球冠上，每個小眼自有角膜透鏡、偽晶錐與感光桿，光軸都指向眼球曲率中心。果蠅（D. melanogaster）約 700–800 個小眼，小眼間角約 4.5°，小眼直徑約 16–18 µm。小眼約為寬度的 10 倍長、由表面向內收窄；色素細胞位於六角頂點，每個由三個小眼共用。蠅類為「神經疊加型」：感光桿分成 7 根獨立的 R1–R7（R8 疊在 R7 下方），R1–R6 排成梯形。透明球體即眼球曲率球：Δφ = D／R。
